sheets.deleteUndo: You can undo this with Ctrl+Z.
sheets.keepOne: A workbook must keep at least one sheet.
sheets.moveUnavailable: The spreadsheet engine cannot move sheets yet; a copy is made.
sheets.copyScope: The copy gets the content with formulas, formatting, column widths, row heights, merged cells and frozen panes; charts, images and comments are not copied.

numberFormat.title: Format Cells › Number
numberFormat.generalHint: General shows numbers as entered, without a fixed format.
numberFormat.accountingHint: Accounting lines up currency symbols and decimal points in a column; zero becomes a dash.
numberFormat.fractionHint: The spreadsheet engine still shows fractions as decimals in the grid; the format is kept in the file and Excel and LibreOffice show the fraction.
numberFormat.textHint: As text, the entry is shown exactly as typed, numbers included.
numberFormat.customHint: Sections: positive;negative;zero;text. 0 and # are digit places, . the decimal separator, , the thousands separator, [Red] a color, "text" literal text.
numberFormat.engineNote: The sample follows the interface language. The grid still shows numbers with the spreadsheet engine's separators.
